need: A crime or thriller in which an FBI agent investigates serial killings.
rationale: Require a serial-killing concept. FBI and investigator wording is optional evidence, so a plot can match without naming an agency or investigator. Phrase boosts favor close wording, and crime/thriller genres provide secondary evidence.

params.q: +("serial killer" OR "serial murder" OR "serial killings" OR "series of murders" OR "string of murders" OR "multiple murders") (FBI OR "special agent" OR "federal agent" OR "federal bureau" OR profiler OR detective OR investigator OR police)
